message.content:
In this repository, find where "memo" objects have derived/computed metadata (used for lists/previews) that is computed from the memo's content rather than set directly by the user — things like a preview/excerpt, word count, reading time, tags extracted from content, title derived from first line, etc.

Please:
1. Locate the file(s) and exact function/method where this derived metadata is computed.
2. Identify what triggers recomputation (e.g., on save, on create/update, a specific hook, a background job, computed on read/render, etc.)
3. List exactly what properties/fields are extracted or computed (e.g., excerpt, wordCount, tags, title, etc.)

Report file paths with line numbers, the trigger mechanism, and the list of extracted properties.

## Summary

This is the `usememos/memos` Go backend. Derived/computed memo metadata is produced in two independent ways: **(A)** persisted "payload" fields (tags, content-property flags, extracted title) computed via a markdown-AST pass and stored on the memo row, and **(B)** an ephemeral "snippet"/excerpt computed on read (never persisted).

### A. Persisted derived metadata (tags, title, content-flags)

**Core extraction logic** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
- `ExtractAll()` (lines 356-422) — single AST walk that computes, in one pass:
  - `Tags` (`#tag` nodes, deduplicated case-preserving) — lines 376-378, 418
  - `Property.Title` — derived from the **first H1 heading** if it's the first block-level node in the document — lines 383-389
  - `Property.HasLink` — presence of a markdown link — line 394
  - `Property.HasCode` — presence of code block/fenced code/code span — lines 396-397
  - `Property.HasTaskList` — presence of a task checkbox — lines 399-400
  - `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — an unchecked task checkbox — lines 401-404
  - `Mentions` (`@user` nodes, deduped) — lines 379-380, 419
  - (Equivalent standalone helpers also exist: `ExtractTags()` lines 143-170 and `ExtractProperties()` lines 193-241, but `ExtractAll` is what's actually used for the payload rebuild since it's more efficient.)

**Trigger / orchestration** — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`
- `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, markdownService)` (lines 74-88): calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(memo.Content)` and assigns the result to `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
- Invoked from:
  - `CreateMemo` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (on memo creation, before persisting)
  - `UpdateMemo` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (only when the `content` field is part of the update mask, i.e. content actually changed) — see lines 432-450
  - `Runner.RunOnce()` (same file, lines 27-72): a batch **background job** that re-lists all memos in pages of 100 and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for every one — used for one-off backfills/migrations (not currently wired into a recurring scheduler in `server.go`; other runners like `s3presignRunner` are invoked via `RunOnce(ctx)` at startup, but no cron currently calls the memopayload runner — it's available as a maintenance/backfill tool).

So recomputation happens **on create and on content-changing update**, plus optionally via an on-demand/batch **backfill job**, not on every read.

### B. On-read/on-render derived metadata (snippet)

**Computation** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
- `GenerateSnippet(content, maxLength)` (lines 264-346): walks the AST, extracts plain text (skipping code blocks, converting tag nodes to `#tag`, autolinks to their URL), then truncates to `maxLength` at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, lines 472-489).

**Trigger** — computed **on read/render**, not stored:
- `getMemoContentSnippet(content)` wrapper — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90` (calls `GenerateSnippet(..., 64)`)
- Called every time a memo is converted to its API response in `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80`
- Also called when building related-memo snippets for `MemoRelation` responses — `memo_service_converter.go:225`, `248` (`batchConvertMemoRelations`), and for single-memo relation loading (`loadMemoRelations`, line 291)
- Also called for notification payloads (comment/mention emails or in-app notices) — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318-391` (`memoNotificationSnippet`)

### Full list of extracted/computed properties
| Field | Computed by | Persisted? |
|---|---|---|
| `Tags` | `ExtractAll`/`ExtractTags` (`#tag` AST nodes) | Yes (`memo.Payload.Tags`) |
| `Property.Title` | First H1 heading text, only if it's the first block | Yes (`memo.Payload.Property.Title`) |
| `Property.HasLink` | Any markdown link present | Yes |
| `Property.HasCode` | Any code block/span present | Yes |
| `Property.HasTaskList` | Any task checkbox present | Yes |
| `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` | Any unchecked task checkbox | Yes |
| `Mentions` | `@user` AST nodes | Not persisted to `Payload` (used internally for mention notifications, see `memo_mention_helpers.go`) |
| `Snippet` | Plain-text excerpt, truncated to 64 chars at word boundary | No — computed fresh on every API response/notification build |

No word-count or reading-time computation exists in this codebase; the closest analog to "preview/excerpt" is the `Snippet` field, and the closest to "title derived from first line" is `Property.Title` (derived from the first H1 heading rather than literally the first line).
